summary: 共享费用分摊与预算/ETC 实现首片 on BASE 4c0d309. Adds costing migration 0005_shared_cost_allocation and 0006_project_budget (generated after the actual leaf 0004, no applied migration edits) for SharedCostAllocationBatch/Line/Receipt and ProjectBudgetVersion/Line/Receipt, with vendor-aware SQLite/PostgreSQL append-only guards, conditional unique active allocation/budget, one-to-one reversal, and draft->posted/reversed and draft->approved/rejected, approved->superseded transitions only. Services add create_shared_cost_allocation_batch / reverse_shared_cost_allocation_batch: pool is strictly posted current nonproject costing cost postings in the period, reversed originals and negative reversal lines are pair-excluded, PH-250 project costs/revenue/cash/drafts/cross-org/cross-period are excluded, missing/non-positive pool refuses, fixed_weights and server-derived revenue/minutes/direct-cost drivers quantize to integer basis points summing 10000 (largest remainder), amounts use exact integer basis_points_clamped_half_up_last_absorb_v1 with last-item absorption and non-negative lines, duplicate active pool and source in multiple pools refuse; each allocation/reversal writes one net-zero AccountingEvent (source nonproject negative, project positive for allocation; exact mirror for reversal) with a SourceConsumption claim, never mutates original source postings, and appends plugin audit plus receipt. Budget services add create_project_budget/approve_project_budget/reject_project_budget/supersede_project_budget: draft versions, four-eyes approval (creator/submitter cannot approve), effective_from in period, one approved version per project/period (old approved superseded in the same transaction), append-only lines/subjects, contract-line snapshots validated for project/termination, expected_version/request_token/dry_run/company lock/period lock, append-only receipts; budget_residual_v1 read model derives budget/incurred/ETC/EAC/variance/over/remaining with missing semantics (null+missing, never zero), frozen issue codes budget_missing/over_budget/budget_lines_exceed_total/subject_attribution_missing. Adds read-only reconciliation and budget/ETC pages (costing routes history_read, period/pool/project filters, empty/missing/issues, role gating, disabled-module history read) and two verifier branches; the verifier now folds its two terminal COUNT queries into already-loaded Organization/LedgerEntry lists to keep the PH-244 query-count budget at 88. No canonical topic/command, no contract schema change, no core migration, no ledger outside costing, no revenue/cash/settlement writes. Actual runs: check 268; manage.py check exit0; makemigrations clean; fresh SQLite migrate+verify ok; scoped 10 tests OK; full 1204 tests/128.753s with only the known 8 macOS baseline failures; verify-change after report (review pending). Reviewer round-1 blockers fixed: (1) request_token idempotency now looks up the org+token receipt before state/duplicate gates for allocation, reversal, budget approve/reject/supersede, and the create digest no longer embeds the computed next version, so replay returns the recorded result even after newer batches/versions exist; replay regressions cover allocate/reverse/create/approve/reject. (2) ETC no longer fabricates zero incurred cost: with no posted project cost fact, incurred_cost_cents remains None and ETC/EAC/variance/over/remaining are null with incurred_cost plus incurred_cost_missing issues; a no-cost regression asserts null+missing rather than budget-equals-ETC.

review.reviewer: independent PH-330 shared-cost/budget-ETC reviewer (fresh context, read-only)
findings: BLOCKER - request_token idempotency is broken for state-changing commands: the receipt lookup runs only after the state/duplicate checks. In `shared_cost_services.allocate_shared_cost`, a replay of a successful pool allocation hits the existing active batch check before `_receipt` and raises; `reverse_shared_cost` similarly hits the existing reversal check before receipt; `budget_services.approve_project_budget`/`reject_project_budget`/`supersede_project_budget` check draft/approved status before `_receipt`, so replays fail instead of returning the recorded result; `create_project_budget` computes the next version number into the digest before receipt, so a replay after another version was created also conflicts. This contradicts the task's request_token/idempotency requirement. Fix: look up the receipt by org+token (and action) before any state/duplicate gate where possible, or split the digest into a stable input digest independent of the computed next version; add replay regressions for allocate/reverse/approve/reject/supersede/create.

BLOCKER - ETC missing-cost semantics are wrong: `budget_etc_snapshot` computes `incurred = ... or 0`, appends `incurred_cost` to `missing` when there are no cost rows, but still returns `incurred_cost_cents=0` and computes `etc/eac/variance/over/remaining` from budget−0. PH-306 requires that a missing incurred-cost input makes ETC/EAC/variance null with missing, not a fabricated zero and a budget-equals-ETC result. Fix: return incurred_cost_cents=None when no posted cost fact exists, set etc/eac/variance/over (and remaining as appropriate) to None, and add a no-cost-fact regression asserting missing/null rather than 0.

OTHER CONTENT CHECKED: costing 0005/0006 use the actual leaf and vendor-aware append-only guards; batch/line/receipt and budget version/line/receipt models include conditional active-allocation uniqueness, one-reversal OneToOne mirror, status/sign/BP 10000 and append-only checks; pool selection is posted nonproject current cost, excludes shared-cost events and reversed originals, excludes PH-250 project cost/cash/revenue/unposted; clamp+last-absorb algorithm and net-zero AccountingEvent/claim with source negative/project positive allocations are implemented; budget draft/approved/rejected/superseded, four-eyes/effective_from/line_key/contract-line snapshot rules; read-only pages/issue codes/permissions (pm company pool denied) and verifier branches are present; 21 files within the PH-330 whitelist, no core migration; full suite 1204/5F+3E/69 baseline; check 268; makemigrations clean; correct scoped 10 OK; fresh verify_integrity ok; verify-change only review gate, no path_out_of_scope. Deviations (no subject actuals, only fixed_weights cross-project counterexample, COUNT merge into 88) are disclosed.
